title: lycopodium × brucei
intro: Lycopodium × brucei, commonly known as Club Moss, is a rare and unique plant species resulting from the cross-breeding of Lycopodium annotinum and Lycopodium cernuum. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Club Moss include its ability to promote detoxification, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
